title: Practice 5: The present for the future, and «let's go»

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: ___ (ехать — to go by vehicle, ride, one way) с нами!
exercises.why: **едем** — present tense (1st person plural) of ехать: one-direction verb (many directions: ездить).

exercises.q: ___ (ехать — to go by vehicle, ride, one way) в город.
exercises.why: **едемте** — imperative (вы, plural or polite) of ехать: one-direction verb (many directions: ездить).

exercises.q: Назло не ___ (ехать — to go by vehicle, ride, one way)!
exercises.why: **езжайте** — imperative (вы, plural or polite) of ехать: one-direction verb (many directions: ездить).

exercises.q: ___ (пойти — to go, set off (on foot)) вы, голубчик, а?
exercises.why: **пойдите** — imperative (вы, plural or polite) of пойти: the perfective of йти, «set out».

exercises.q: ___ (ехать — to go by vehicle, ride, one way), мой друг!
exercises.why: **едемте** — imperative (вы, plural or polite) of ехать: one-direction verb (many directions: ездить).

exercises.q: ___ (пойти — to go, set off (on foot))! — пшикнул Алеша.
exercises.why: **пшли** — imperative (вы, plural or polite) of пойти: the perfective of йти, «set out».

exercises.q: Не ___ (ехать — to go by vehicle, ride, one way), доктор!
exercises.why: **езжайте** — imperative (вы, plural or polite) of ехать: one-direction verb (many directions: ездить).

exercises.q: ___ (пойти — to go, set off (on foot)) к свиньям на хутор!
exercises.why: **пшёл** — imperative (ты, singular) of пойти: the perfective of йти, «set out».

exercises.q: Садись, ___ (ехать — to go by vehicle, ride, one way) с нами.
exercises.why: **езжай** — imperative (ты, singular) of ехать: one-direction verb (many directions: ездить).

exercises.q: ___ (пойти — to go, set off (on foot))! — говорит он пугливо.
exercises.why: **пшла** — imperative (ты, singular) of пойти: the perfective of йти, «set out».

exercises.q: Так и ___ (ходить — to go, walk, there and back or in general).
exercises.why: **ходим** — present tense (1st person plural) of ходить: many-directions verb (one direction: идти).

exercises.q: ___ (ехать — to go by vehicle, ride, one way)… кто тебя держит?
exercises.why: **езжай** — imperative (ты, singular) of ехать: one-direction verb (many directions: ездить).

exercises.q: ___ (летать — to fly, there and back or in general) без опаски.
exercises.why: **летай** — imperative (ты, singular) of летать: many-directions verb (one direction: лететь).

exercises.q: О, не ___ (ходить — to go, walk, there and back or in general)!
exercises.why: **ходи** — imperative (ты, singular) of ходить: many-directions verb (one direction: идти).

exercises.q: ___ (ходить — to go, walk, there and back or in general) в дверь!
exercises.why: **ходи** — imperative (ты, singular) of ходить: many-directions verb (one direction: идти).

exercises.q: Как же, ___ (ходить — to go, walk, there and back or in general).
exercises.why: **ходим** — present tense (1st person plural) of ходить: many-directions verb (one direction: идти).

exercises.q: ___ (пойти — to go, set off (on foot)), чтоб ты издохла! — крикнул он.
exercises.why: **пшла** — imperative (ты, singular) of пойти: the perfective of йти, «set out».

exercises.q: Так, как мы ___ (летать — to fly, there and back or in general) во сне.
exercises.why: **летаем** — present tense (1st person plural) of летать: many-directions verb (one direction: лететь).

exercises.q: Брам и бом-брам-шкоты тянуть ___ (пойти — to go, set off (on foot)) фалы!!
exercises.why: **пшел** — imperative (ты, singular) of пойти: the perfective of йти, «set out».
